github_commits: Commits per month in the GitHub organisations of Global Health Engineering

Source: R/github_commits.R
github_commits.Rd

Monthly number of commits on the default branches of all repositories of an organisation, separately for public and private repositories. The table holds counts only. It has no row per repository and no information about who made a commit. Private repositories are counted and never named.

Usage

github_commits

Format

A tibble with 9 variables

organisation

Login of the GitHub organisation.

visibility

Visibility of the repositories on the snapshot date. Levels: public, private.

month

First day of the month (UTC) in which the commits were authored.

commits

Number of commits made by people on the default branches, without merge commits, commits by bots and automated commits. Forks are not counted.

commits_bot

Number of commits authored by bot accounts and by GitHub Actions. Not part of commits.

commits_automated

Number of commits pushed by a device or a script under the account of a person, such as sensor data on a schedule. Recognised by the first line of the message with the patterns in data-raw/github_automated_commits.csv. Not part of commits.

commits_merge

Number of merge commits (more than one parent) that are neither by bots nor automated. Not part of commits.

commits_assisted

Number of commits counted in commits whose message carries a trailer of a coding agent (Co-Authored-By for Claude or Copilot, Assisted-by, or the Claude Code line). A lower bound, since the trailer is optional.

repos_active

Number of repositories with at least one commit counted in commits in that month.

Source

GitHub REST API, read with data-raw/data_processing_github.R.

Details

Every commit on a default branch falls into one of four columns: commits (made by a person, the number to use), commits_bot (authored by a bot account or a GitHub Action), commits_automated (pushed by a device or a script under the account of a person) or commits_merge (merge commits). Forks are not counted. The month is the month of the author date in UTC. Every organisation has a row for every month from August 2021, or from the month it was created, up to the last complete month before the snapshot date in github_organisations. Visibility is the visibility on the snapshot date.

Use github_commit_change() to compare the last 12 complete months with the 12 months before.
